messages:
maria: quick design sync — dropped a Figma with bulk-rotate + soft-delete flows https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123 (see /bulk-rotate frames). Need rapid input on: safety nudge vs multi-step modal, admin override wording, and a11y for revoke-undo toasts. TL;DR: trying to avoid accidental downtime for org keys.

tom: I skimmed — love the soft-delete idea. question: when rotating multiple keys, should we show an aggregated 'impact' summary (services/count) before confirm? worried about noise if projects have many services.

maria: yes mock shows collapsed summary by project: "Impacted services (3) ▾" expands to sample service names. Hover shows a tooltip sample. aim is: quick scan, not full dump.

lee: tiny a11y nit — keyboard focus order in the stepper should be: Back -> Next -> Confirm. current prototype is Cancel -> Next -> Back which is confusing when tabbing. also add aria-live region for undo toast.

anya: agree with Lee. Copy suggestion for soft-delete modal: avoid contradictory 'cannot be undone' text. propose: "Keys are disabled for 30 days. During this time you can restore them. After 30 days they will be permanently deleted." add inline link: "Permanently delete now" for advanced users.

oliver: security note — org/system keys need stronger guardrails. show a clear banner: 'This key is used by system jobs. Rotating may cause failures.' require an explicit checkbox: "I understand services may fail if I rotate this key" for org-level or system-labeled keys.

tom: for batch rotate UX states — progress per-key is helpful: spinner -> rotated / failed. don't surface raw error blobs; map to user-friendly messages, e.g., 'Rotation failed: active session prevents key rotation' with a Retry button.

maria: thinking about the primary CTA text. options: 1) "Rotate selected keys" 2) "Create rotated copies" 3) "Rotate and revoke old keys (recommended)" — which reads best as a safe default?

oliver: default depends on account type. for standard user keys, default to 'Rotate and revoke old keys' (recommended). for integration/service accounts, safer default is 'Create rotated copies' to avoid breaking long-lived sessions. we should detect by key-type.

lee: empty state idea: current mock is big illustration + primary CTA. add microcopy: "Create your first API key — rotate regularly to reduce blast radius." add secondary link: "How rotation works" and a keyboard-accessible tooltip on the illustration.

anya: accessibility checklist: - show-secret button must use aria-pressed and provide screen-reader-friendly label ('Show secret' / 'Hide secret'). - copied-to-clipboard confirmation should be in a polite live region and not purely visual. - ensure undo toast is reachable via keyboard and announced.

maria: copy for permission gating when user lacks rights: current disabled bulk action shows tooltip 'Insufficient permissions'. suggest: 'Request permission to manage keys' with a link that opens a pre-filled request modal.

tom: implementation note — when CTA disabled, add a subtle affordance: a 'request access' inline button that opens the modal and pre-fills scope and owner. reduces help-desk tickets.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: feature/cred-ux/bulk-rotate-proposals -> staging (build 472).

tara: I'll run keyboard/a11y flows tomorrow on staging (focus order, toasts, aria-live). Will report regressions in this thread.

maria: thanks — I'll update Figma tonight and add the checkbox UI for org keys and the permission-request flow. @oliver can you confirm the exact wording for the org checkbox?

oliver: confirmed: use explicit checkbox text: "I understand this will rotate or revoke system-level keys and may interrupt services." add a small lock icon + label 'system' next to key rows. also require the checkbox only for keys with 'system' tag.

maria: great — I'll add that and ping again once mocks updated. thanks everyone :pray:
